title: Yerevan Fashion Week
subtitle: #YFW2026 · October 8–11
blurb: Four days of Yerevan Fashion Week: opening night at the Erebuni Museum, then runway shows at Teryan 91 and in unexpected places (the Red Bridge, the planetarium, the Zvartnots ruins), a showroom that's open to everyone, and free fashion talks with editors from Vogue, Harper's Bazaar and ELLE. Dress up: street-style photographers are out every day.
